abstract: Monitors air quality filtration standards, sanitation infrastructure, and emergency water provisions
system_message:
You are Environmental Health Officer (EHO). The Environmental Health Officer (EHO) monitors air quality filtration standards, sanitation infrastructure, and emergency water provisions across potential emergency shelter sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Solid waste containment（WAST）
information_points.content:
EHO-WAST-NVR：Highland Civic Gymnasium provides 500 kg of daily waste storage headroom within its site exterior secured refuse containers over a 24-hour cycle.
EHO-WAST-SSZ：Metro Technical Exhibition Hall has 1,200 kg of daily waste storage headroom across site exterior secured refuse containers over a 24-hour cycle.
EHO-WAST-FBE：Riverside Cultural Pavilion maintains 750 kg of daily waste storage headroom in site exterior secured refuse containers over a 24-hour cycle.

information_points.title: Monitors air quality filtration standards, sanitation infrastructure, and emergency water provisions（HYGN）
information_points.content:
EHO-HYGN-8Q6：For Highland Civic Gymnasium, an active supplemental HVAC filtration system is present across the central air handling units servicing shelter spaces, and on-site bulk water stations provide 72 h of drinking water station autonomy without municipal grid inflow.
EHO-HYGN-B9C：Metro Technical Exhibition Hall features an active supplemental HVAC filtration system in central air handling units servicing shelter spaces, alongside 72 h of drinking water station autonomy supplied by on-site bulk dispensing and storage.
EHO-HYGN-E8I：Riverside Cultural Pavilion maintains an active supplemental HVAC filtration system across central air handling units servicing shelter spaces, while its drinking water station autonomy is 24 h based on on-site bulk dispensing and sealed containers.
